title: Analytics & Reports
description: Learn how to use analytics and reports to track store performance, sales metrics, and customer behavior.
content:
Analytics & Reports

Analytics and reports help you understand your store's performance, track sales, monitor customer behavior, and make data-driven decisions.

Dashboard Analytics

The dashboard provides key metrics:

  • Total sales
  • Orders count
  • Customers count
  • Products sold
  • Revenue trends
  • Conversion rates

Sales Reports

Track sales performance:

  • Sales by date range
  • Sales by product
  • Sales by category
  • Sales by customer
  • Sales trends
  • Revenue breakdown

Product Reports

Analyze product performance:

  • Best-selling products
  • Low-performing products
  • Product views
  • Add-to-cart rates
  • Conversion rates
  • Inventory turnover

Customer Reports

Understand customer behavior:

  • Customer acquisition
  • Customer lifetime value
  • Repeat purchase rate
  • Customer segments
  • Geographic distribution
  • Purchase patterns

Order Reports

Track order metrics:

  • Order volume
  • Average order value
  • Order status breakdown
  • Abandoned carts
  • Order fulfillment time
  • Return rates

Traffic Reports

Monitor website traffic:

  • Page views
  • Unique visitors
  • Traffic sources
  • Bounce rate
  • Time on site
  • Device breakdown

Exporting Reports

Export reports for analysis:

  • CSV export
  • PDF reports
  • Excel format
  • Scheduled reports
  • Email reports

Custom Reports

Create custom reports:

  • Select metrics
  • Choose date ranges
  • Apply filters
  • Save report templates

Real-Time Analytics

Monitor real-time activity:

  • Live sales
  • Active visitors
  • Current orders
  • Real-time revenue

Best Practices

  • Review reports regularly
  • Track key metrics
  • Compare periods
  • Identify trends
  • Make data-driven decisions
  • Export important reports
